clusters.title: Nvidia and Tech Market Volatility
clusters.summary: Nvidia's stock experienced extended declines following critical remarks from the U.S. government and upcoming earnings preparations. Broader tech stocks also slid as markets awaited key corporate tests and economic commentary regarding artificial intelligence.

clusters.title: Black Friday Deals and Retail Investigations
clusters.summary: Retailers rolled out early Black Friday and Cyber Monday promotions across various consumer goods. However, a new investigation revealed that nearly a third of advertised deals offered no actual savings to shoppers.

clusters.title: Entertainment Awards and Pop Culture Milestones
clusters.summary: Beyoncé made Grammy history as the first artist to reach 100 nominations, while Taylor Swift earned five nominations for 2027. Meanwhile, actors like Glenn Close and Zendaya were celebrated at the Governors Awards.

clusters.title: NFL Injuries and Season-Ending Setbacks
clusters.summary: The NFL landscape was shaken by major injuries, including Detroit Lions star Aidan Hutchinson sustaining a torn ACL. Patriots quarterback Drake Maye also faced potential time away due to a significant lower leg injury.

clusters.title: Space Exploration and Astronomical Discoveries
clusters.summary: Astronomers and space agencies reported major milestones, including the James Webb Telescope revealing a hidden giant planet. Additionally, SpaceX experienced mixed mission results while preparing for future launches.

global_summary: Today's news spans fluctuating financial markets driven by tech and energy developments, alongside widespread retail promotions marred by deceptive discounting investigations. In entertainment, historic Grammy nominations and awards ceremonies highlighted major milestones for top artists. Meanwhile, the sports world reeled from significant injuries across the NFL, and astronomers shared groundbreaking space discoveries from deep-sky telescopes.
